name: Balfron
description: Balfron was a small terrestrial planet located in the Dolomar sector in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. It had several casinos where planets could be won or lost in a game of sabacc, including The High Stakes Casino, where Han Solo arranged for Lando Calrissian to meet the Tonnika sisters as part of an elaborate prank.
